title: Marine Corps Seeks Applications for the Elite Warrior Athlete Program
intro: The Marine Corps is now accepting applications for the Elite Warrior Athlete Program, designed to support elite Marine athletes in competing at higher-level sports events. This program provides an opportunity for Marines to pursue excellence in individual sports that fall outside the scope of the All-Marine Sports program.

sections.markdown:
Participants will receive the resources and support necessary to compete at national and international levels, helping to elevate their athletic careers while maintaining their military service.

To apply, interested candidates can access the application through the Semper Fit All-Marine Sports webpage at [https://www.usmc-mccs.org/allmarinesports](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/allmarinesports). Completed applications and any inquiries should be directed to [AllMarineSports@usmc-mccs.org](mailto:AllMarineSports@usmc-mccs.org). Applications are accepted year-round.

For further details on eligibility and program benefits, Marines can refer to [MARADMIN 040/26](https://www.marines.mil/News/Messages/Messages-Display/Article/4403499/headquarters-marine-corps-hqmc-semper-fit-branch-seeks-elite-warrior-athlete-ap/).
